children: Finland facility services firm's Q3 net sales rose 0.4% yr/yr to EUR 84.2 mln
Q3 adjusted EBITA increased, driven by ICT and personnel savings and improved Swedish operations
Company saw continued weakness in Finnish cleaning and support services, offset by property maintenance growth
Luotea expects 2026 adjusted EBITA to increase from 2025's EUR 7.0 mln
Company to focus on improving operational efficiency in Sweden under new CEO
Luotea to continue targeted profitability improvement measures in Finland
COST SAVINGS - Co said increased Q3 adjusted EBITA was mainly driven by savings in ICT and personnel expenses
SWEDISH OPERATIONS - Co said improved performance in Swedish operations contributed to higher adjusted EBITA
PROPERTY MAINTENANCE GROWTH - Co said demand for property maintenance services in Finland grew strongly, with 11% growth in add-on sales
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the environmental services & equipment peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Luotea Oyj is €2.20, about 26.9% above its October 27 closing price of €1.73
The stock recently traded at 9 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 2 three months ago
